verdict.rationale: Mollie publishes an llms.txt page index at docs.mollie.com/llms.txt, and a probe confirmed it returns HTTP 200. Every docs page also has a documented markdown mirror (append .md), which is explicitly framed as something agents can use to discover and read pages. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt bundle or deeper agent-specific usage guidance beyond the index and markdown convention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.mollie.com/llms.txt. Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
